## Context
Child of epic 5c34-4343-a3e6-4ad5; follows task c3fc-4398-cdd2-4d37 (taxonomy/matrix). Phase 3+4: candidate questions, scoring, selection of the 10, and Kehoe-persona validation.

## Plan
Draft ~25 candidate questions from the highest-severity assumed/unknown gap-matrix cells. Score each on: risk-reduction leverage; answerability in discovery (names a specific obtainable artifact — e.g. current ACES ICD, WAHBE MOU, contraction budget model, Deloitte M&O contract, TSB decision record); and whether the answer changes a decision-model input (pain/coupling/change/write-back/contract pins). Show the rubric; keep the full candidate table in Appendix B. Select exactly 10; each carries: failure mode de-risked (corpus citation), the specific WA gap, the artifact to request, and answer-to-plan mapping. Validate: run the 10 past the Kehoe persona via a new harness `evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/run-eval.mjs` (adapted from evaluation-wa-report/run-eval.mjs; Bedrock us-east-1 sonnet-class, profile evaluations/virtual-cio/profiles/wa.md), asking whether the questions are credible, answerable, and confidence-building (not audit-flavored) from the buyer's seat. Keep raw request/response in wa-discovery-questions-review/raw/; write findings.md; revise questions per findings and note what changed. Trace-check: every question cites >=1 corpus failure instance and >=1 specific WA gap.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 10 questions: `test "$(grep -c '^### Q' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10`
- [ ] Scoring rubric + candidate appendix present: `grep -q 'Scoring rubric' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md && grep -q '^## Appendix B — candidate questions' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`
- [ ] Every question carries the four required fields: `test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*De-risks' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10 && test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*Why WA' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10 && test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*Ask for' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10 && test "$(grep -c '^- \*\*How the answer moves the plan' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md)" -eq 10`
- [ ] Persona-validation raw artifacts committed: `ls evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/raw/*request*.json && ls evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/raw/*response*.json`
- [ ] Validation findings + post-validation revision note committed: `test -f evaluations/virtual-cio/wa-discovery-questions-review/findings.md && grep -q 'What changed after validation' docs/analysis/wa-discovery-questions-2026-08.md`

## Testing
Deterministic grep/test/ls commands above from repo root on branch feat/wa-discovery-questions. The Bedrock run itself is external; its committed raw request/response JSON is the durable proof (no secrets in artifacts). Docs+evaluations only; no app build.
